rule.name: PendingFuturesNotFailedOnClose
rule.message: This map keeps pending requests as futures, but the close method of its class never completes them, so every caller still waiting hangs forever. In close, complete every entry exceptionally (pending.values().forEach(f -> f.completeExceptionally(new IllegalStateException("closed")))) and then clear the map. An exception fits only when the entries are completed elsewhere before the class closes.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $closers := ('close', 'shutdown', 'stop', 'disconnect', 'destroy', 'dispose', 'end', 'cleanup'), $bookkeeping := ('clear', 'size', 'isEmpty', 'containsKey', 'remove', 'put', 'putIfAbsent', 'get', 'add', 'contains'), $loggers := ('log', 'LOG', 'logger', 'LOGGER') return //ClassDeclaration/ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[@Static = false()] [ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection')]] [.//TypeArguments//ClassType[@SimpleName = ('CompletableFuture', 'Future', 'CompletionStage', 'SettableFuture', 'Promise', 'DeferredResult')]] [let $name := VariableDeclarator[1]/@Name, $body := ancestor::ClassBody[1], $closing := $body/MethodDeclaration[@Name = $closers or ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'PreDestroy']], $called := $closing//MethodCall/@MethodName return exists($closing) and empty(($closing | $body/MethodDeclaration[@Name = $called])//*[self::MethodCall or self::ConstructorCall] [not(self::MethodCall and (@MethodName = $bookkeeping or *[1][@Name = $loggers]))] [.//*[(self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess) and @Name = $name]])]
